all_defined_iou: TP/(TP+FP+FN) on every pair with nonempty actual or predicted growth; false alarms on no-growth pairs count as0; both-empty undefined

bootstrap.interval: percentile2.5–97.5% for incident macro means and paired U-Net-minus-baseline group differences
bootstrap.missing: per-model defined groups; paired intervals first intersect metric-specific defined PAIRS, then average within groups; all admitted/excluded counts saved
bootstrap.unit: whole incident group; all pair means move together

calibration.assignment: left closed, right open except final bin includes1; fixed equal-width bins

conditional_iou: only pairs with positive observed growth in the declared domain

front.anchor: current footprint available at each forecast ISSUE; not sequence index0
front.coarse_pixels: no forced inclusion; front can be empty when neighboring center exceeds1000m
front.distance: scipy EDT center-to-nearest-affected-cell-center in projected meters
front.name: front_1000m

macro: mean defined pair metrics within group, then mean defined group metrics; defined/undefined counts retained
pooled: exact repeated-cell-forecast-weighted metrics; descriptive, separately named, not independent fires
protocol_clarification: Before any front calculation, INITIAL was clarified to current issue-time footprint. No sequence-first front metrics were computed.
test_panel_status: held out from fitting, previously inspected, reused diagnostic evidence

thresholds.0.05: frozen validation-selected main operating point, applied to all methods
thresholds.0.5: fixed diagnostic comparator, applied to all methods

undefined: zero denominator, empty domain, and single-observed-class ROC-AUC/AP remain null
